title: Hidden in Plain Sight: an Empirical Study about The Instruction Stacks of Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.37332v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents send their models more than the user's prompt: they add instructions, tool definitions, and environmental context that form an instruction stack. This stack guides execution and changes across releases, yet remains largely unexposed to users and insufficiently characterized in research. We present a longitudinal, cross-agent study of the instruction stacks captured in the first model requests of 1,886 releases of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, and OpenCode. Under controlled conditions, we analyze their composition and evolution and trace changes in the four open-source agents to documented motivations. Our findings show why examining the system prompt or reporting the model alone provides an incomplete account of agent inputs. translated_title: 《藏于显眼之处：关于编程智能体指令栈的实证研究》
translated_abstract: 编程智能体发送给模型的远不止用户的提示词：它们还会附加指令、工具定义和环境上下文，这些内容共同构成一个“指令栈”。该指令栈指导智能体的执行过程，并随版本发布不断变化，然而它对用户而言几乎不可见，在研究中也缺乏充分的刻画。我们对 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code 和 OpenCode 五个智能体共 1,886 个版本中首次模型请求所捕获的指令栈，开展了纵向、跨智能体的研究。在受控条件下，我们分析了这些指令栈的组成与演变，并将四个开源智能体的变化追溯至有据可查的动机。我们的研究结果表明，仅检查系统提示词或只报告所用模型，无法完整描述智能体的实际输入。工具定义在三个智能体的最新请求中占据主导地位，而偶发的集中式修订则会改变控制工具使用、署名和代码风格的指令。此类修订可能…
tldr: 该论文通过对五个主流编程智能体共 1,886 个版本的大规模纵向实证研究，首次系统揭示了隐藏在模型请求中的“指令栈”的构成与演变，表明仅看系统提示词或模型名称无法完整刻画智能体的真实输入。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a longitudinal, cross-agent empirical study of the hidden "instruction stacks" in 1,886 releases of five coding agents, showing that tool definitions and evolving instructions—not just the system prompt or the underlying model—dominate and shape what models actually receive.
